memory_bridge: Use one thread-wrapped parcel in two scenes: a hand gives it directly with everyday 给（gěi）; a warehouse line repeatedly furnishes parcels in 供给（gōng jǐ）. Both readings dip and recover, but direct giving and formal supplying remain distinct.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 给 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: The wrapping thread fits snugly as you lower the parcel into another person’s hands: 给（gěi）, “to give.” Your hand returns upward as gěi completes its dip.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 供给 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
readings.overlay: At the 供给（gōng jǐ） depot, “to furnish,” a forklift dips beneath the wrapped crate and raises it onto the supply line, tracing third-tone jǐ.

readings.editorial_reason: Promoted because 这个 is a common modern anchor for this distinct reading.
